prompt: Is "How tall is the Empire State Building?" a statistical question?
hint: Ask yourself whether you would need to collect a set of data to answer this question.

hints.text: Ask yourself whether you would need to collect a set of data to answer this question.
The Empire State Building is one building with one height. A statistical question needs answers that vary from one case to the next.
The answer is No (choice B), because the question has one fixed answer.

explanation: A statistical question anticipates variability, so its answer comes from data that differs from case to case.
This question is about a single building, and that building has one fixed height.
With only one possible answer there is no variability, so the answer is No, choice B.
